tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: The conversions this server offers: for each, the job kind, the accepted source extensions, the target (a format name, or the kind itself for a mesh tool), the upload cap in MB, whether a zip is accepted, and the page where the same conversion runs in a browser.

tools.name: conversion_notes
tools.description: Before uploading anything: for a pair of formats (for example from "fbx" to "glb"), what survives the trip (skeleton, shape keys, materials, vertex colours), what is lost, the known limits of the two formats, and the page for that pair. Says so when the pair is not offered and names the nearest ones

tools.name: convert_file
tools.description: Starts a conversion. Give the target (`to`: a format name such as glb, fbx, obj, stl, ply, dae, usdz, 3mf, or a mesh tool kind from list_tools such as mesh-decimate) and the file as an https link (`file_url`) or as the file attached to the chat (`file`). The source format is read from the file name;

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: The state of a conversion started by convert_file: queued, processing, ready, failed (with the reason), expired, or refused when the file needs a choice only the page can offer.

tools.name: result_link
tools.description: For a ready conversion: the download link (valid 3 days, no sign-in), the file name, the expiry date, and a link that opens the result in a viewer on the site.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: convert_file · Private data: convert_file, job_status, result_link · Public sink: list_tools · Destructive: list_tools, convert_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: convert_file · Private data: convert_file, job_status, result_link · Public sink: list_tools · Destructive: list_tools, convert_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
